title: Updating the First Coordinate
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,c$, let $v:	ext{Fin}(2)\to\mathbb{N}$ have values $a$ at index $0$ and $b$ at index $1$. Updating $v$ at index $0$ to $c$ gives the function with values $c$ at index $0$ and $b$ at index $1$.
